preconditions.description: The number of game pieces n is between 1 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= p_i <= 10**9 for p_i in p)
preconditions.description: Each piece strength p_i is between 1 and 1,000,000,000 inclusive.
The number of piece strengths matches the number of pieces.
The length of the assignment string matches the number of pieces.

preconditions.expression: all(x in 'AB' for x in assignment)
preconditions.description: Each character in the assignment string is either 'A' or 'B'.

postconditions.expression: return_value == max(sum(p[i] for i in range(n) if assignment[i] == 'B'), max(sum(p[i] for i in range(j) if assignment[i] == 'B') + sum(p[i] for i in range(j, n) if assignment[i] == 'A') for j in range(n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The return value is the maximum strength Bob can achieve by flipping at most one prefix or suffix of the assignment string.
